abstract: Free trade in audio-visual services has faced opposition on the grounds that foreign media undermine domestic culture, and ultimately, global diversity. We assess the media-culture link using name frequencies as a measure of tastes. Using a 47-year panel of French birth registries, we first show that names appearing on television shows, movies, or in songs are about five times more popular than other names. Most, but not all, of this relationship arises from endogeneity: song and script writers, as well as performers and their parents, select names that would be popular anyways. Using name attributes, fixed effects, and lagged popularity as controls, our regression results suggest that media affect choices by informing parents of unfamiliar names.
abstract_zh: 视听服务自由贸易面临反对，理由在于外国媒体会侵蚀本土文化，并最终损害全球文化多样性。我们以名字使用频率作为文化品味的衡量指标，评估媒体与文化之间的关联。基于法国出生登记系统47年的面板数据，我们首先发现：出现在电视节目、电影或歌曲中的名字，其流行度约为其他名字的五倍。这种关联大部分（但非全部）源于内生性：歌曲和剧本作者、表演者及其父母会优先选择本就可能流行的名字。通过控制名字属性、固定效应及滞后流行度变量，回归结果表明：媒体通过向父母传递不熟悉的名字信息，从而影响其选择。
title: Exposure to Foreign Media and Changes in Cultural Traits: Evidence from Naming Patterns in France
title_zh: 接触外国媒体与文化特征变化：来自法国命名模式的证据

abstract: Governments frequently intervene to support domestic industries, but a surprising amount of this support goes to ailing sectors. We explain this with a lobbying model that allows for entry and sunk costs. Specifically, policy is influenced by pressure groups that incur lobbying expenses to create rents. In expanding industry, entry tends to erode such rents, but in declining industries, sunk costs rule out entry as long as the rents are not too high. This asymmetric appropriability of rents means losers lobby harder. Thus it is not that government policy picks losers, it is that losers pick government policy.
abstract_zh: 政府经常干预以支持国内产业，但令人惊讶的是，大量此类支持流向了陷入困境的行业。我们通过一个允许进入和沉没成本的游说模型来解释这一现象。具体而言，政策受到压力集团的影响，这些集团通过承担游说费用来创造租金。在扩张性行业中，进入往往会侵蚀此类租金，但在衰退行业中，只要租金不过高，沉没成本就会排除进入的可能性。这种租金的不对称可获取性意味着失败者会更努力地进行游说。因此，并非政府政策选择了失败者，而是失败者选择了政府政策。
title: Entry and Asymmetric Lobbying: Why Governments Pick Losers
title_zh: 进入与不对称游说：为何政府选择失败者
